title: Heavenly Mediterranean Eggs Frittata
description: A fluffy, floral frittata with savory bonito shavings and low‑glycemic Mediterranean flavors, perfect for late‑night cravings.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and lightly grease an ovenproof skillet with olive oil.
Whisk eggs, feta, salt, pepper, and lemon zest until blended.
Heat skillet over medium, then sauté garlic for 30 seconds.
Add spinach and cherry tomatoes, cooking until spinach wilts, about 2 minutes.
Pour egg mixture over vegetables, stirring gently to distribute evenly.
Sprinkle chopped dill and bonito shavings on top of the eggs.
Cook on stovetop for 3-4 minutes until edges set and center slightly runny.
Transfer skillet to oven and bake for 7-8 minutes until frittata is puffed and lightly golden.
Remove from oven and let rest 2 minutes before slicing into squares.
Serve warm with a fresh salad or drizzle of olive oil if desired.
